result.summary: The page is largely intact, with no broken or missing functional elements. The main visual problem is a low-contrast promo banner; the rest are minor alignment and copy-clarity issues. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom are treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The promo banner text is very low-contrast: the light mint-green headline and gray subtext on the pale green gradient background are hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors for the headline and supporting copy, and/or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The delivery fee for Green Bowl Poké ("€0.90 delivery") appears to be misaligned and sits lower than the delivery fee labels of the neighboring restaurant cards in the same carousel row.
issues.suggestion: Align the restaurant names and fee/price rows to a shared baseline within the carousel card layout.

issues.description: The promo banner's offer copy reads awkwardly: "3 free deliveries for you / Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10" is unclear about whether the minimum order applies to the discount or the delivery.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the wording, e.g. "3 free deliveries with code TALLINN3 on orders over €10."
